Container.Name: JellyHub
Container.Overview: Independent Jellyfin frontend development preview. Configure integrations in Connections after signing in as a Jellyfin administrator. Playback is not implemented. Appdata must be writable by UID 1000.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web UI.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent settings and API keys. Must be writable by UID 1000.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Bootstrap address needed for first login. Saved Connections settings override this value.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Set to 1 when accessing JellyHub through HTTPS.
